invariants.rationale: The result metadata should contain some write statuses after successful execution.

meta.value: After processing inputRecords, result should have recorded write statuses.

invariants.rationale: inputRecords must be non-null as it is processed in the method.

meta.value: inputRecords is used to build profiles and partition records; must not be null.

invariants.rationale: The sourceReadAndIndexTimer option should either be empty or have a timer.

meta.value: sourceReadAndIndexTimer is an Option and can be empty or have a timer but not null in between.

invariants.rationale: No write status should have errors at method end.

meta.value: WriteStatuses should not have errors after successful commit.

invariants.rationale: If inputs exist, result should reflect non-empty write statuses.

meta.value: If there are input records, write statuses should not be empty.
